title: May I ask some help, how to you guys do AI art ? for pixel ?
author: Nonirik
selftext:
I'm developing a survival like game, like "vampire survival", would anyone recommend a way to generate sprites like breath of fire 3 ? 

The base structure of the game is already done, but as I imagine for everyong the biggest issue is the graphics.

Can someone give me some insight on how to do this ?

does not need to be exactly like bof3, it can go like death must die, I just want to make complex characters and keep it coeherent with the other elements in the game, like skill and things like that.

thank you for your time.
